name: wealthink
description: Official Wealthink marketplace — install the Wealthink plugin to understand Indian markets through Wealthink's connected map of the news.

plugins.name: wealthink
plugins.description: Understand Indian markets with Wealthink, a coherence engine that links recent Indian financial news into one map: what's moving markets today, how the stories behind a company, sector, macro driver or portfolio connect, why something happened and what followed, and what supports or challenges your view. Includes the MCP connection setup guide.
